home.title: Word practice
home.subtitle: Short English–Turkish cards: tap a word to see the translation, mark what you know, and browse the full deck.
home.statsDesc: SQLite (native) or localStorage (web) keeps study progress; match rounds reset each visit.

study.title: Study
study.tapHint: Tap the word to reveal Turkish.

match.title: Match pairs
match.subtitle: Tap a word in English, then its Turkish translation. Correct pairs disappear; wrong picks clear after a moment.
match.needMore: Add at least two words to the deck for matching.

deck.title: Word list
deck.subtitle: All entries from demo/src/vocab/seedWords.ts — add rows or import JSON to grow the deck.

more.title: About
more.body: This sample app ships with the appspresso monorepo: Capacitor, Vite, React Router, Jotai, and shared UI components.
more.themeHint: Uses the same preference as the full template (saved in localStorage).
more.stackBody: The full template (onboarding, SQLite, Query, etc.) runs from the repo root with npm run dev.
more.readmeHint: See the repository README for CLI, CI, and create-appspresso.
more.toastBody: useToastProvider is already in AppspressoRootProviders. Import toast from appspresso/lib/toast (or sonner) anywhere under the tree. Native push is initialized separately via NotificationProvider (Capacitor listeners → Jotai store); there is no server in this demo to receive a real push.
more.tableCardBody: appspresso/components/ui/table — horizontal scroll on narrow viewports, bordered shell, row hover, caption and footer slots.
more.tableCaption: Example UI primitives from the kit
more.tableRowButtonNote: Primary, secondary, outline, ghost, destructive, link
more.modalBody: Prop-based modal: open, onOpenChange, optional title, handle bar, backdrop dismiss, and headerEnd. Uses createPortal and body scroll lock when open.
more.mockAuthBody: This demo passes a single createDemoAuthAdapter instance to AppspressoRootProviders (no Firebase/Supabase). Same AuthLayout and /auth/login route as the main template.
more.formCardBody: react-hook-form + Zod via appspresso/components/form; invalid submit shows field error.
more.checkboxHint: Standalone Checkbox (Radix) + Label — tap or use the checkbox to toggle.
more.toggleHint: appspresso/components/ui/toggle — oval switch; use name/value in forms when needed.
more.imageCardBody: appspresso/components/ui/image: default import; autoSize / fullWidth; fill + fit (contain | cover | …) for framed layouts; previewModal opens a centered AppModal lightbox with blurred backdrop; previewSrc and built-in error fallback.
more.imageDemoBadAlt: Expected fallback when the image cannot load
more.imageDemoFillCaption: fill + cover (parent aspect-video) + tap for modal
more.imageDemoFillAlt: Splash graphic in a cropped frame
more.imageDemoFullWidthCaption: fullWidth + contain (fits width, letterbox in box)

shell.cardItem1Body: Radix Accordion + shared variants. Default is card styling for list-like blocks.
shell.cardItem2Body: Single-expand mode: opening one section closes the other.
shell.flushItem1Body: Border-only rows without card chrome; multiple sections can stay open.
shell.flushItem2Body: Use variant="flush" on the root Accordion for dense settings-style lists.
